sector_model: Software and ad verification, but the stock is governed by a pending all-cash merger: price is pinned to the 13.60 deal price, so valuation is a merger spread and deal-completion risk question, not an operating-value question. FCF and P/E are context only.
thesis: DoubleVerify Holdings (NYSE: DV), digital ad verification. Q3 2026 10-Q (filed 2026-10-30) read: Q3 revenue 205.6M (+9%), 9M revenue 580.3M vs 542.7M (+7%), Q3 NI 15.9M vs 10.2M, 9M NI 35.3M vs 21.3M; 9M operating cash flow 136.4M, purchases of PP&E 31.4M (capitalized software not separately extracted); cash 250.9M; total liabilities 216.5M vs equity 1,133.4M; 156.2M shares outstanding at 2026-09-30. KEY FACT: on 2026-08-06 DV agreed to be acquired by Neptune BidCo US Inc. (parent of Nielsen Company (US) LLC) for 13.60 in cash per share; stockholders adopted the merger agreement on 2026-10-29; German, Cypriot and Australian competition clearances received by 2026-10-13 (Australian 14-day wait period after publication); 2026-11-09 8-K says closing is expected in Q4 2026; outside date 2026-05-06 (auto-extends to 2027-08-06 in some cases); financing includes a new revolving facility and a marketing period. Close 13.56 (2026-11-19) = 0.29% below 13.60 (spread 0.04, own arithmetic). Market cap 13.56 x 156.189M = 2.12B (approximation: period-end outstanding, excludes dilutive awards) = 32.8x TTM NI 64.6M (50.650 FY2025 + 35.257 - 21.321). Conclusion: this is a deal-arbitrage situation. Holding gives at most about 0.3% to the deal price if it closes within weeks, with downside to an unaffected price if it breaks. It is not a researched long idea and not a fresh value thesis.
counterthesis: If the deal closes, upside is capped at 13.60 (about 0.3% over the last close) and the shares are cashed out, creating a taxable event for no gain beyond the spread. If it breaks (financing, regulatory, litigation; two stockholder complaints alleging proxy disclosure deficiencies, unserved), the stock could fall materially below 13.56; the unaffected price was not researched here. A superior proposal is unlikely this late. Business quality (revenue +7%, rising GAAP NI) matters only if the deal fails.
invalidation: Not applicable as a long thesis. Reclassify if the merger agreement is terminated (then research as an operating company at the unaffected price) or if the closing 8-K is filed (then delisted).
